confidence_notes: Holistic estimate with weak direct price data. Cuba has a dual-currency and informal-rate environment, frequent shortages, and high price volatility, so tourist-facing USD prices and CUP prices can differ sharply. Restaurant and café anchors are the least uncertain; accommodation anchors are rougher because casas particulares and registered hostels vary widely. Cocktail and wine are based on the local price relationship to beer, since direct knowledge is weak. FX: 0.7088 is dated 2026-03-20, the latest RBA observation I could identify. A later third-party figure (0.6947 on 2026-10-16) could not be confirmed against the official RBA daily table, so the rate may be stale by about 2 percent.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Latin American and Caribbean capitals with dollarized tourist pricing, such as Santo Domingo and Mexico City at ordinary tourist-facing venues, adjusted for Cuba's supply shortages and currency constraints. Accommodation is benchmarked against Caribbean capitals with comparable guesthouse and mid-range hotel supply.
